data.title: 户隐憧子 · 办公桌后的解扣卸防
data.description: 反锁的学生会办公室里，窗帘严严实实地拉拢。卸下会长威严的憧子学姐坐在宽大的办公桌边，指尖轻巧地解开第一颗领扣。她微微倾身靠近，紫黑长发自肩侧滑落，略带疲惫却无比宠溺地将额头抵在对方肩窝。
data.action: loosening collar, leaning against shoulder, affectionate tired sigh
data.lighting: warm desk lamp casting long shadows
data.promptProse: Inside the quiet, locked office room at twilight, Togakushi Touko loosens her blouse collar while seated at the dark wooden desk. She leans her forehead gently against the viewer's shoulder, her long dark purple hair cascading as she relaxes all defenses.
data.animaCaption: Touko leaning tenderly on a shoulder after loosening her collar in the office.
